en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small harbor with two docked vessels: a larger passenger steamer and a smaller sailing ship or fishing boat. Behind them stands a low wooden quay building with a gabled roof. In the foreground are grassy banks with a small rowboat pulled up on shore and a tree framing the right side of the image. The water and distant low shoreline are visible under a cloudy sky. Printed captions appear at the lower left and right edges.
